data.narrative:
Firehawk Aerospace is a Series A defense & security company that has raised $25M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 11 same-sector comparables at Series A and Series B stages, comprising 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Singularity. The peer set ranges from $125M to $3.0B in valuation.

Two triangulation methods apply here. Stage-progression modeling uses the $25M capital base as a proxy valuation and applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A-to-subsequent-stage step-up mechanics, implying $50M. Peer-median analysis across the 11 comparables yields a median valuation of $1.0B, with the sample spanning Dream Security at $3.0B (Series B) down to smaller entrants. This wide range ($125M–$3.0B) reflects sector heterogeneity in execution stage and market position within defense tech.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $42.5M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $525M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around Firehawk's relative competitive positioning and near-term product commercialization trajectory versus the peer set. Reconciling the stage-progression method ($50M) with the peer-median approach ($1.0B) suggests the company's valuation will depend heavily on differentiated technical capability and contract pipeline evidence relative to Series B benchmarks.
